sections_target.text: Introduction

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I2, which must be performed on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The technical specification of traveling crane 
capacity 32000 kg, span 9300 mm, total weight 9560 kg, speed 20/5 m/min, power 
0.8/0.18 kw

The first draft was initiated, tested and approved by Eng. Abd El Mohsen Mohammed, 
General Manager of

Nag 
Hamady hyd. PS
Safety precautions

A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Stop the crane and switch off the power supply
Safety fence caution marks surrounding the work area is required

Wear the safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ...etc.

sections_target.text: Tools and equipment

Set of wrenches,
 Screw driver

Grease for lubricating,
 Cleaning material
Work to be carried out

Check up the crane during 
operation and review the lifting mechanism for traveling crane

Check up the mechanical 
parts, rail, vibration and test the brake for the crane and carriage

Check up the oil level in 
reduction gear box, control and safty instrument

Check up the structure 
for the crane. Review the joints, rivits, pully, hook, welding and bolts

Check up clean the 
mechanical parts for crane, carriage and reduction gear boxes

Inspect and clean 
the lifting mechanism of the main crane and the travel crane

Check up the greasing 
mechanism for the carriage and operate the crane for test
